summary: Tested Home page (/home) and Progress page (/progress) redesign for ChessGuru. All features working correctly: accuracy > 0% (fixed fallback), review progress tracking, behavioral insights, win trend with correct insight (NOT 'Holding steady'), blunders rising detection, danger zones with severity badges.

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ /api/home/dashboard-v2 accuracy now correctly falls back to computing from game_analyses when player_profiles.average_accuracy is 0
✅ last_battle includes 'behavior' field with behavioral insight from coach_summary
✅ Frontend Progress page correctly compares win RATES (not absolute wins) for insight text
✅ 'Win rate dropped from 33% to 14%' shown correctly instead of misleading 'Holding steady'
✅ 'BLUNDERS RISING' label shown in red when blunders are increasing
✅ Accuracy Journey chart renders with colored dots (green=win, red=loss, gray=draw)
✅ Danger Zones patterns are clickable and navigate to /training?focus={pattern_type}
✅ Review Progress shows progress bar and pending count with link to Lab
✅ Review progress strip on Home page navigates to /lab when clicked
